text: Thank you. Now, let's talk about the area where you live. Debora, what do you like doing outdoors in your area?

text: Well, I'm from the Canary Islands. It's a mountain island, it's amazing. You can go for hiking, trekking… you can visit many places, it's really nice. And if you like, you can go to visit the beach, you can do surfing, snorkel…

text: Well, in my area… actually I'm living in a small town, so it doesn't have too many things to do during the night, because it's quite small. But we have a really close town, just close to mine, so…

text: Thank you. And Debora, please tell me something about the people who live near you.

text: Thank you. Now, let's talk about clothes. Inma, what kind of clothes do you wear when you do sport?

text: To be honest, I'm always using, like, simple clothes. I don't like too many colours at the same time or something like that, so I'm always wearing black things, simple… trainers.

speaker: Examiner
text: Now, in this part of the test you're going to talk together. Here are some pictures that show different types of food. Do you like these types of food? Say why or why not. I'll say that again: do you like these different types of food? Say why or why not. All right? Now, talk together.

text: OK, Inma. I love the desserts, because for me it's my favourite food in the whole world. I love cake, chocolate, all type of dessert. What do you like? What type of food do you like?

text: Well… I don't like too much the desserts, to be honest, because they are just too sweet, and I don't like the really, really sweet things. So… but from here I can say maybe my favourite one could be fruit, or also vegetables. What do you think about fruit and vegetables?

speaker: Debora
text: Well, I don't like too much fruit, and I don't like too much vegetables. But I know I need to eat, because it's healthy. It's the most healthy food we have.

speaker: Debora
text: Now, Inma, what do you think about the fast food?

text: Well, I don't like too much the fast food neither, because it just makes me feel so heavy. So no, it's just not for me.

text: Thank you. Inma, do you think fruit is healthy?

text: Yeah, of course. I think so. It hasn't anything from outside, like chemicals or something like that, so yeah, I think it's healthy.

text: OK. And what about you, what do you think, Debora?

text: I think it's really good for your body, but today it is more expensive than the fast food.

text: Do you think cake is nice?

text: Do you think pizza is popular?

speaker: Examiner
text: And Debora, which of these types of food do you like best?

text: Thank you. And Inma, which of these types of food do you like best?

text: I think if I have to choose one, I will choose fruit, because I really like all kind of fruit. So yeah, in summer they are perfect.

speaker: Examiner
text: Now, do you prefer having a large meal or just a snack at lunchtime, Inma?
